name: Focus
description: A pomodoro timer that keeps its place: close the lid, come back, the clock is still right
author: Lattice

config.label: Start the next phase automatically
config.help: Off means the timer stops at each boundary and waits for you.

sections.title: Starting and pausing
items: The button reads Start before the phase begins, Resume when you stopped halfway, Pause while it runs.
Reset puts the current phase back to its full length and stops it.
The colour and the label change with the phase: Focus, Break, Long break.

sections.title: Lengths and rounds
items: Focus length, Break length and Long break length are the three durations, all set in the inspector.
Long break after counts finished rounds: 4 means three short breaks and then a long one.
Set it to 0 to turn long breaks off — then every break is a short one.
The small counter reads which round of the cycle you are in, e.g. 2 / 4.

sections.title: Automatic or manual
items: Start the next phase automatically off means the timer stops at every boundary and waits for you.
That is the default on purpose: a break that starts itself is a break you did not decide to take.
On, it rolls straight from focus into break and back until you pause.

sections.title: It survives the lid closing
items: The timer stores the moment it will end, not the time left — sleeping, closing the lid or restarting loses no minutes.
A phase that ended while the machine was asleep is finished the moment it comes back, not restarted.
Only a paused phase stores a remaining time, which is why Resume continues where you left off.

sections.title: Two Focus widgets
items: They are two views of one timer: start on one and the other follows.
Both reaching the end in the same millisecond is handled — the round is recorded once, not twice.
The history of finished rounds is capped at the last 20, so the file cannot grow without limit.

changes: First release: focus, short break and long break, with a per-cycle counter.
Keeps time by storing the end moment, so sleeping or closing the lid does not lose minutes.
Two widgets stay in step; a round is recorded once even when both finish together.
